_schema: Mechanic-named groups of live values that belong together ACROSS modules. A group: id; label; blurb (what the mechanic is looking at); aliases (words Find and the picker match); applies_to (platform keys, same as mes.known_good: 'any', 'giorgio_gme_2.0t'); systems (mes.systems keys); sections [{title, why (what reading these side by side shows), together (true = one side-by-side row), channels (cuore.live.channels ids only)}]; not_read_yet [{name, module, source}] = values MES shows that CUORE has no channel for (source names the evidence file; never a value, scale or limit); related [{group, why}]. module_platforms: modules whose catalogued DID list was written for these platform keys; a DID channel from such a module shows only on a matching car, a standard PID or adapter reading always shows. Bands, units and scales are NEVER stored here: they come from the channel registry and mes.known_good at render time. labels = mechanic names for channels whose registry name is a raw formula. Marque and car specifics live here, not in code.

groups.label: Battery and charging
groups.blurb: Battery voltage as each module sees it, the battery sensor, and what the engine is doing.
